definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers medical expenses. In Japan, enrollment in a public health insurance system is mandatory for all residents. The two main types are employee health insurance (社会保険) and National Health Insurance (国民健康保険).

examples.japanese: {健康保険|けんこうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
{健康保険|けんこうほけん}{証|しょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget to bring your health insurance card.

examples.english: In Japan, everyone is required to be enrolled in some form of health insurance.

notes:
Japan has universal health insurance. All residents must enroll in some form of {健康保険|けんこうほけん}. Often abbreviated to {健保|けんぽ}.

TYPES:
- ⟦{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}→社会保険：18894_shakaihoken⟧ ({社保|しゃほ}): employee health insurance (through employer)
- ⟦{国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}→国民健康保険：24671_kokuminkenkouhoken⟧ ({国保|こくほ}): National Health Insurance (for self-employed, retirees, etc.)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {健康保険|けんこうほけん}{証|しょう}: health insurance card
- {健康保険|けんこうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to enroll in health insurance
- {健康保険|けんこうほけん}⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: health insurance premium

COPAY:
The standard patient copay is 30% of medical costs, with the insurance covering the remaining 70%. Children and elderly have reduced copay rates.
